verdict.rationale: E2B documents a programmatic SDK that covers the full sandbox lifecycle: create, runCode, files.list/read/write, commands.run, setTimeout, kill and metrics. It also documents API-key and explicit client configuration, plus lifecycle webhooks, so an agent can drive the product end to end in code. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage beyond first-party docs.
